title: Iowa State, U.S. Department of Energy extend contract for Ames National Laboratory
summary_en: Iowa State University and the U.S. Department of Energy have extended the management and operating contract for Ames National Laboratory for another five years. Under the contract, the federal government owns the national lab’s facilities, land and major assets. The university manages and operates the national lab and earns a management fee each year.
